document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
As you exhibit your prowess with a skeet gun, you hear a soft 
pop! Hearing a bullet whine past your ear. You wheel around. 
No gunman is in sight. The other shooters have not noticed the 
gunshot. Despite their stares, you abruptly leave the competition. 
Move on a day and go to the ship activity table at 187. 
(590)
